title: NomicLaw: Emergent Trust and Strategic Argumentation in LLMs During Collaborative Law-Making
reasoning: The paper introduces a simulation framework for LLMs to deliberate over legal and ethical dilemmas. It specifically evaluates LLM behavior using jurisprudential themes grounded in ethics and moral philosophy, such as Fairness/Justice, Harm/Risk, and the Common Good (Solidarity), and benchmarks their responses to ethical vignettes like discrimination and autonomous vehicle collisions.
